title: Storage Partitions
items: What does a storage partition group?
The configuration for one or more applications that need to be managed together
All drives of the same class
All nodes in an I/O group
Storage Partition 將一個或多個需一併管理之應用的 Configuration 分成一組。
A storage partition acts as what?
A virtual storage system focused on the logical resources used by an application
Storage Partition 如同聚焦於應用邏輯資源的虛擬儲存系統。
Which objects does a storage partition typically contain?
Volume groups, volumes, hosts, host clusters, and host mappings
Partition 把應用相關的 Volume Group、Volume、Host、Host Cluster 與 Mapping 分成一組管理。
Within a storage partition, where must all volumes be?
Partition 內所有 Volume 都必須在 Volume Group 內。
Which volumes can a host in a storage partition be mapped to?
Only volumes in the same storage partition
Only volumes in a side partition of another system
Host 只能映射到同一 Partition 的 Volume (另有 Side Partition 的例外)。
Which hosts can a host cluster in a storage partition contain?
Only hosts in the same storage partition
Host Cluster 只能包含同一 Partition 的 Host。
Can volumes in a storage partition be mapped to other IBM Storage Virtualize systems?
Partition 內的 Volume 不能映射到其他 IBM Storage Virtualize 系統。
Why do storage partitions have rules such as all volumes in volume groups?
So partitions can be non-disruptively migrated or configured for HA without conflicts
這些規則確保 Partition 可不中斷移轉到 Grid 內其他系統，或設定為 HA 而不與兩邊既有資源衝突。
Is ODX supported for volumes in a storage partition?
Offloaded Data Transfer (ODX) 不支援 Partition 內的 Volume。
簡報 S4；Concept Guide Ch11 Note
Can existing storage resources be added directly to a storage partition?
No; a draft partition must be used
Yes, if they have no mappings
可在 Partition 內新建資源，但既有資源不能直接加入，須透過 Draft Partition。
What is special about constructing a draft partition?
Some partition requirements are not enforced, so resources can be added iteratively
It can only contain new objects
建構 Draft Partition 時不強制全部需求，可反覆加入資源並解決相依性。
When can a draft partition be published?
Only when all requirements of a partition are met
Draft Partition 必須所有 Partition 需求都滿足才能 Publish。
Which operations are NOT possible for a draft partition?
Migration and making it highly available
Draft Partition 不能移轉，也不能設為 HA。
When building a draft partition in the GUI, what does the GUI indicate?
Which volumes, volume groups, and hosts are added automatically
GUI 協助加入 Volume 或 Volume Group，並指出哪些 Volume、Volume Group 與 Host 會自動一併加入。
What does a partition management IP address provide?
Management access to the partition through CLI (SSH) or REST API
每個 Partition 可指派靜態管理 IP，供 CLI (SSH) 與 REST API 管理。
What happens to the partition management IP address when the partition is migrated?
It stays on the source system
Partition 移轉時管理 IP 會跟著 Partition 移動，自動化與監控不中斷。
To which port is a partition management IP bound when it is created?
The same Ethernet port as the system management IP, or the lowest-numbered if there are several
Partition 管理 IP 與系統管理 IP 綁在同一 Ethernet Port；有多個系統管理 IP 時選編號最低者。
Which resources are partition-scoped and move with the partition during migration?
Volumes, volume groups, hosts, and IP addresses
Volume、Volume Group、Host 與 IP Address 屬 Partition-scoped，會隨 Partition 移轉。
Concept Guide Ch11 Partition-scoped and system-scoped resources
Which resources are system-scoped and do NOT migrate with the partition?
System users, user groups, and ownership groups
系統使用者、User Group 與 Ownership Group 屬 System-scoped，不隨 Partition 移轉。
User accounts scoped to a specific partition that move with it during migration
Users who can manage all partitions
Partition User 是屬於特定 Partition 的帳號，移轉時一起移動，確保在目標系統仍可存取。
What does Server Name Indication (SNI) enable for storage partitions?
Partition-level REST API access over the system management IP when no partition IP is configured
SNI 讓 Client 在未設定 Partition IP 時，也能透過系統管理 IP 以 Partition 層級存取 REST API。
With SNI, how does the client specify the target partition?
In the URL query string as ?partition=name
With a separate TCP port per partition
Client 在 X-Host Header 以 <小寫 Partition UUID>.fs.ibm.com 格式指定目標 Partition。
How can a certificate be assigned to a storage partition?
Through the CLI (SSH), REST API, or the Storage partitions panel in the GUI
設定管理 IP 後，可用 CLI、REST API 或 GUI 的 Storage partitions 面板設定 Partition 憑證。
What happens to the partition management certificate when the partition is migrated?
Partition 移轉時，管理憑證也會一併移轉，確保自動化與監控持續可用。
Do administrators create or manage partition-specific SSH host keys?
No; the system presents them and keeps them consistent during migration and failover
系統自動提供 Partition 專屬 SSH Host Key，並在移轉與 HA Failover 時保持一致，管理者不需建立或管理。
In an HA partition, from where is certificate management performed?
Only from the Active Management System
Only from the preferred management system
Partition 處於 HA 時，憑證管理只能在 Active Management System 進行。
Concept Guide Ch11 Storage partitions and replication
How are storage partitions made highly available?
By associating a replication policy with the partition
By adding a second I/O group
為 Partition 關聯 Replication Policy，即可在兩個獨立系統之間提供 HA。
How is disaster recovery configured for volume groups in partitions?
By linking two storage partitions in different systems
兩個不同系統的 Storage Partition 可連結，為其中一個或多個 Volume Group 設定 DR。
Can volume groups within one partition use different replication policies?
Yes, allowing different RPOs or selective replication
No, all must use the same policy
Partition 內的 Volume Group 可設定不同 Replication Policy，達到不同 RPO 或只複製部分 Volume Group。
Can HA and DR be configured simultaneously on a partition?
Yes, with DR replication on volume groups in an HA partition to a third system
HA 與 DR 可同時設定，在兩個生產系統間 HA，再複製到第三系統做 DR。
What does a side partition contain?
Side Partition 只包含 Volume Group 與 Volume，提供不複製到遠端的本機 Volume。
In an HA partition, which hosts can discover volumes in an associated side partition?
Only hosts on the local system
若關聯的 Partition 有 HA Policy，Side Partition 的 Volume 只會被本地系統上的 Host 探索到。
What do vCenter partitions help VMware environments achieve?
Multitenancy, with each vCenter acting as a separate system
可註冊多個 vCenter，每個 vCenter 如同獨立系統並屬於一個 Ownership Group，協助 VMware 環境達成 Multitenancy。
What does a common storage partition for a vSphere deployment include?
All VMFS datastore volumes managed by one vCenter and the ESX host objects
常見的 vSphere Partition 包含單一 vCenter 管理的所有 VMFS Datastore Volume，以及該部署的 ESX Host Object。
In legacy mode for VMFS-only deployments, which features are NOT available?
Legacy Mode 不為 VMFS 與 ESX Host 使用 Partition，因此無法使用 Policy-based HA 與 Partition Migration。
In vCenter partition mode, does the VMFS datastore require a child pool or ownership group?
vCenter Partition Mode 以 Partition 管理 VMFS Datastore 與 ESX Host，不需要 Child Pool 或 Ownership Group。
How can you split a storage partition?
Create a draft partition with the original partition as the source, add resources, then publish
建立 Draft Partition 並指定原 Partition 為來源，加入資源後 Publish，資源即移到新 Partition。
Concept Guide Ch11 Managing storage partitions
What must be deleted before a storage partition can be deleted?
All partition-scoped snapshot policies associated with the partition
刪除 Storage Partition 前，必須先刪除與其關聯的所有 Partition-scoped Snapshot Policy。
Which management interface is mentioned for combining storage partitions?
可在 Management GUI 合併 Storage Partition；CLI 為 mergepartition。
Storage partitions are the basis for which features?
Partition migration, high availability, and disaster recovery
簡報指出 Storage Partition 是 Migration、HA 與 DR 的基礎。
What is NOT a reason given for using storage partitions?
To simplify scoped management of resources
To allow non-disruptive migration within a grid
Partition 的目的在於簡化範圍管理、支援不中斷移轉與 HA；與 RAID Parity 無關。
Where in the GUI do you configure a partition management IP address?
The partition panel in the management GUI
使用 Management GUI 的 Partition 面板設定 Partition 管理 IP。
Which kinds of new objects can be created directly in a storage partition?
Hosts, host clusters, volumes, and volume groups
可直接在 Partition 內新建 Host、Host Cluster、Volume 與 Volume Group。
In SNI-based routing, which configurations support redirection of requests?
SNI 的請求重新導向支援 FlashSystem Grid 與 HA (含 AMS Failover)。
Can a host in an HA partition be mapped to local volumes?
Yes, if the volumes are in a side partition associated with that storage partition
有 Replication Policy 的 Partition 中，Host 可映射到關聯 Side Partition 中的本機 Volume。
Why is a partition management IP useful during HA failover?
It ensures seamless failover for automation, monitoring, and external tools
It avoids the need for quorum
為 HA Partition 指派管理 IP，可讓自動化、監控與外部工具在 Failover 時無縫接續。
How many vCenters can be registered for multitenancy with partitions?
Multiple vCenters, each self-contained and belonging to an ownership group
可註冊多個 vCenter，彼此不知道對方資源，各屬一個 Ownership Group。
Which statement about a draft partition is true?
It has no effect until it is published
It replaces the original partition automatically
Draft Partition 在 Publish 前沒有作用，可用來建構符合需求的 Partition。
How many draft partitions are allowed per system?
每個系統只允許一個 Draft Partition。
During a partition split, when can a partition-scoped snapshot policy be assigned to the draft partition?
Only when no volume groups are associated with the policy
Split 期間，Partition-scoped Snapshot Policy 只有在未關聯任何 Volume Group 時才能指派給 Draft Partition。
